_doc: Signs on the Denver Grand Prix lap: ONLY what OSM implies per junction (grade tagged). No sign was seen; no post position and no face is claimed. Posts that may carry signs are in lamps.json / signals.json (a sign post and a lamp post are not told apart from the air unless the eye could). Written by signs_build.py from source/osm.json.

colfax_note: OSM today tags Colfax two lanes each way with bus:lanes=designated (the bus rapid transit rebuild). The newest free pictures (2022, and NAIP 2023-09) show the street before it. Bus-lane signs implied by those tags are therefore NOT in the surveyed state (PLAN D8); they are listed here as changed since, not surveyed.
